Visit note | 2025-03-12 04:30 PM | Dr. Moinul Haque, Neurology | Patient: Mahmuda Munshi, 31, female. Mrs. Munshi presents today describing a throbbing headache on one side of her head and notes that she feels an intense need to lie in a dark room until the pain passes. She mentions that her attacks are triggered by skipping meals while travelling in Mohammadpur. She works as a police constable and reports having about 6 headache days a month. She has no chronic comorbidities. On examination: BP 118/71 mmHg, pulse 82 bpm, weight 75 kg. Cranial nerves are intact and neurological exam is unremarkable. Assessment: Migraine. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep a headache diary, sleep and eat at regular times, and limit screen time. Follow-up in 3 months with the headache diary.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Sanjida Chowdhury, 32, female. Mrs. Chowdhury returns for a review of her ongoing lower belly ache and a burning sensation when passing urine. She is a lawyer and states that the problem started after a long bus journey without toilet stops to Rangpur. She has a history of Hypothyroidism. On examination: temperature 99.7°F, BP 122/71 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, weight 80 kg. Abdominal examination reveals mild suprapubic tenderness without guarding. Assessment: Uncomplicated urinary tract infection. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to drink at least two litres of water daily and not to hold urine for long periods. Follow-up in 1 week if symptoms continue.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 03:30 PM | Dr. Sabrina Chowdhury, Cardiology | Patient: Tapan Bhattacharya, 73, male. Mr. Bhattacharya reports experiencing dizzy spells, a fluttering sensation in his chest, and getting tired easily, though he denies any palpitations at all, noting only breathlessness and ankle swelling. He first noticed these issues while resting after a family lunch in Khulna. He works as a homemaker and has no significant comorbidities. On examination: pulse 115 bpm and irregular, BP 126/75 mmHg, weight 51 kg. Heart sounds are irregularly irregular with no added murmurs. Assessment: Atrial fibrillation. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to limit tea and coffee, avoid alcohol, and report any fainting at once. Follow-up in 2 weeks with an ECG and kidney function tests.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 03:30 PM | Dr. Shahadat Hossain, ENT | Patient: Ishrat Siddique, 46, female. Mrs. Siddique describes having a runny nose, frequent sneezing fits, and itchy eyes. She mentions that her symptoms became much worse since keeping a cat at home in Bashundhara. She works as a shopkeeper and experiences about 12 sneezing fits a day. She denies any prior medical conditions. On examination: BP 129/77 mmHg, pulse 81 bpm, weight 56 kg. Nasal mucosa appears pale and boggy with clear secretions. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid dust, wear a mask when cleaning, and wash bedding weekly. Follow-up in 1 month.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 04:00 PM | Dr. Arif Hossain, Pulmonology | Patient: Hafiz Kabir, 53, male. Chest auscultation reveals vesicular breath sounds with prolonged expiration. Assessment: Bronchial asthma. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid dust and smoke, keep the bedroom well aired, and learn the correct inhaler technique. Follow-up in 1 month to check inhaler technique.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 04:00 PM | Dr. Imran Kabir, Gastroenterology | Patient: Hafiz Sarkar, 33, male. He was advised to eat regular meals, keep a food diary, and reduce tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-03-13 04:00 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Orin Hossain, 70, female. Mrs. Hossain attends for a follow-up visit regarding her slow-healing cuts and passing urine often. On examination: fasting glucose 11.8 mmol/L, BP 126/73 mmHg, pulse 86 bpm, weight 71 kg. Peripheral pulses are palpable and foot examination shows intact reflexes. Visit note | 2025-03-15 09:30 AM | Dr. Farhana Kabir, General Medicine | Patient: Mitu Alam, 39, female. Mrs. Alam complains of brittle nails and constant tiredness. Visit note | 2025-03-15 10:00 AM | Dr. Shirin Akter, Pulmonology | Patient: Sabbir Bepari, 69, male. Mr. Bepari returns for review complaining of fever and sharp chest pain when breathing in.
